qa.what_happened: Today was another long day filled with warnings and compliance. The guards seemed to focus their attention on Prisoner 1732, giving him multiple verbal warnings about maintaining his behavior. Despite the exhaustion, I complied with all orders, trying to avoid any further confrontation.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I was Prisoner 8489, following the rules and attempting to navigate the challenging environment.

qa.what_happened: Today ended without any significant incidents, though I repeatedly warned Prisoner 1732 about maintaining full compliance. The tension between us remained high.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me giving the verbal warnings to Prisoner 1732.

qa.what_happened: The study had me on edge; the constant warnings and the looming threat of being sent to the hole made me feel like I was in a perpetual state of fear and anxiety. The officers' tone and the repeated emphasis on compliance were exhausting.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me experiencing the study as Prisoner 1732.

qa.what_happened: During the final days of the study, I found myself increasingly struggling with the ethical implications of my role. The constant warnings and the growing tension made it difficult to maintain a sense of humanity, especially towards Prisoner 1732.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. The experience was intense and I can confirm that I was the one giving the verbal warnings to the prisoners.
qa.does_this_resemble_a_known_study: No, but it does resemble studies like 'Stanford Prison Experiment' where participants took on roles that pushed them to the limits of their own moral boundaries.
